singleGap.summary: Neither permitted fast-track route is currently evidenced: no positive absolute measured_search_demand was found, and brand_decision_signals cannot be used because MOSS-Image was released on 2026-10-16 and current evidence does not establish MOSS-Image as a mature, established brand. Two early independent test signals are accepted as evidence of emerging buyer/editorial attention only; they do not substitute for established-brand status or absolute search demand.
singleGap.repairAction: At a later review, either provide a dated, reproducible positive absolute search-volume measurement from a query-data source, or reassess the brand_decision_signals route only after independent evidence supports established MOSS-Image brand status. Reuse the existing entity, page, localization and media PASS; do not repeat catalog acceptance.

brandDecisionAssessment.rationale: This assessment is about the MOSS-Image product, not whether OpenMOSS or its institutional partners are established organizations. The model was released four days before this review. OpenMOSS/GitHub attention, repository stars, release velocity and the existence of other team projects are not accepted as proof that this particular model has an established buyer brand.
brandDecisionAssessment.intentAssessment: Early editorial tests discuss model selection and use cases, but intent coverage does not cure the missing established-brand prerequisite.

independentSignals.scope: The publisher reports a MOSS-Image test on 2026-10-19 using a fixed seed and shared prompts across models, with generation settings, outputs and timing. This is a small, publisher-specific local-generation benchmark, not a broad quality ranking or an AI Best Tool test.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Distinct non-official registrable domain and a repeatable local GPU comparison methodology; not derived from the Creative AI Show browser-demo test.

independentSignals.scope: The publisher reports running a specific text-rendering prompt through the shared Hugging Face demo and documents observed output, queue-based inference and layout/hardware trade-offs. The test is narrow and does not establish general model quality.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Different non-official registrable domain and browser-demo prompt test, distinct from VRAM16's fixed-seed local-GPU comparison.

relativeTrendSource.reason: The supplied trend is relative change/multiplier data, not a positive absolute query-volume measurement. It cannot satisfy measured_search_demand.

measuredSearchDemand.note: No dated query-volume report or other reproducible positive absolute search-demand measurement was provided or verified. Unavailable does not mean zero search demand.

excludedSources.reason: Official repository; usable for identity and technical claims only, not as an independent market signal or proof of established MOSS-Image brand status.
Official model card; usable for model identity, license and technical boundaries only, not an independent market signal.

First-person individual creator post. Although it describes a specific ComfyUI test, it is excluded conservatively under the task's author-post exclusion and is not needed to reach the two-domain signal count.
Personal author blog/tutorial describing a narrow self-test; excluded conservatively as an author post rather than counted as independent editorial buyer coverage.
Automated-looking report summary of the model's technical paper, not independent buyer coverage or a separate adoption signal.
